newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Gov. appoints state housing dept. director.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Gov. appoints state housing dept. director.

text.p: California Gov. Pete Wilson on Friday appointed Richard Mallory as director of the state's Department of Housing and Community Development.

He will manage the $146-million-per-year department, which sets housing standards, assists local governments in the development of housing policy and oversees affordable housing programs for the elderly, the poor and the homeless.
Mallory will receive a salary of about $108,000 per year. The appointment is subject to Senate confirmation.
Mallory, 44, served as senior vice president of LEADS Corp, a consulting group. He has worked for LEADS since 1993.
